name: manor-desert
description: Noble's Manor, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10f): the shipped Manor drawn again as a qasr: flat-roofed sandstone and mud-brick masses at three heights behind crenellated parapets, the porch tower a slotted windcatcher with an iwan, lattice rawshans, a palm garden round a fountain (II), the ballroom under a clerestory lantern (III), a ribbed cellar (IV).
